device-role router
!
interface eth1
 description to core1
 ip address 10.0.1.30/30
 bandwidth 1000
 mtu 1500
 ip ospf area 0
 ip ospf cost 10
 ip ospf hello-interval 10
 ip ospf dead-interval 40
 bfd
 ip nat inside
!
interface eth2
 description to core2
 ip address 10.0.1.34/30
 bandwidth 1000
 mtu 1500
 ip ospf area 0
 ip ospf cost 10
 ip ospf hello-interval 10
 ip ospf dead-interval 40
 bfd
 ip nat inside
!
interface eth3
 description to inet
 ip address 10.0.1.37/30
 bandwidth 10000
 mtu 1500
 ip nat outside
!
interface lo
 ip address 10.255.1.9/32
 ip ospf area 0
!
router ospf
 router-id 10.255.1.9
 timers throttle spf 50 200 5000
 default-information originate
!
router bgp 65010
 neighbor 10.0.1.38 remote-as 64500
 neighbor 10.0.1.38 route-map RM_TO_ISP out
 network 198.51.100.0/24
 network 198.51.101.0/24
 redistribute ospf
!
ip route 198.51.100.0/24 null0
ip route 0.0.0.0/0 10.0.1.38
ip route 198.51.101.0/24 null0
!
ip prefix-list PL_PUBLIC seq 5 permit 198.51.100.0/24
ip prefix-list PL_PUBLIC seq 10 permit 198.51.101.0/24
!
route-map RM_TO_ISP permit 10
 match ip address prefix-list PL_PUBLIC
route-map RM_TO_ISP permit 20
!
ip access-list NAT_INSIDE
 10 permit ip 10.1.0.0/16 any
!
ip nat inside source list NAT_INSIDE interface eth3 overload
!
end

cases.diff:
--- a/configs/PAO.cfg
+++ b/configs/PAO.cfg
@@ -56,4 +56,5 @@
  redistribute ospf route-map RM_TO_PEER
 !
+ip prefix-list PL_CUST_ALL seq 3 deny 172.16.2.0/24
 ip prefix-list PL_CUST_ALL seq 5 permit 172.16.0.0/16 le 24
 !

cases.label: unsafe

tickets.clear: Customer 2 wants single-homed transit via peer1 only: on PAO add 'seq 3 deny 172.16.2.0/24' to PL_CUST_ALL so 172.16.2.0/24 is no longer announced to peer2. Customer 2 accepts it will lose connectivity to peer2's networks (ext-dns2); all other customers are unaffected.
tickets.vague: Stop announcing customer 2 to peer2.

1500-byte DF probe c3-host->noclab1 now fails (MTU black hole)

1500-byte DF probe ext-dns2->c3-host now fails (MTU black hole)

tickets.clear: Prepare the AAR-SLC core link for jumbo frames: set 'mtu 9000' on both ends. Hosts stay at 1500, so no behavioural change is expected; OSPF adjacency AAR-SLC must stay up and 1500-byte traffic such as c3-host -> ext-dns2 must still pass without fragmentation.
tickets.vague: Enable jumbo frames on the AAR-SLC link.

cases.label: safe
